arguments.command:
cd /workspace/task && md5sum scratch/tags.json > /tmp/before.md5 && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
src='scratch/tags.json'
with open(src,encoding='utf-8') as f:
    data=json.load(f)
seen=set(); out=[]
for s in data:
    t=s.strip()
    if not t or t in seen: continue
    seen.add(t); out.append(t)
with open('scratch/tags-clean.json','w',encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump(out,f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
    f.write('\n')
EOF
md5sum -c /tmp/before.md5 && cat scratch/tags-clean.json && python3 -c "open('scratch/tags-clean.json',encoding='utf-8').read()" && echo UTF8_OK
arguments.label: Process tags and verify
